Callout.Name: Convoy of Speeding Vehicles
Callout.Message: Several vehicles travelling together at speed.
Callout.Advisory: Three or four vehicles, no plates readable.

Script.Line: Five of them, all running together.
They are changing lanes as a block. That is deliberate.
The cars are modified. You can hear them from here.

Lines.Approach: Three or four of them running together and none of the plates readable.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
